title: The geometric morphism on the equivalent small pro-etale site models
statement: For schemes $T$ in universe $t$, use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathscr S_T$ be the published equivalent small model proEtaleSiteModel$(T)$ with topology transported along AsSmall.down; define sfCbcSite$(T)$ to be this presented site in module universe $t+1$. For $f:U\to V$, transport the pro-etale base-change functor [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] to these models. Define sfCbcModelDirect$(f)$ as precomposition on sheaves of sets in universe $t+1$, sfCbcModelInverse$(f)$ as its sheafified left Kan extension, and sfCbcModelAdjunction$(f)$ as their canonical sheaf adjunction. Define sfCbcMorphism$(f):\mathrm{sfCbcSite}(V)\to\mathrm{sfCbcSite}(U)$ in the contravariant inverse-image convention of [def-pur-adic-site-strict-quotient-interface] from this adjunction, its finite-limit-preserving inverse image and the published induced algebraic inverse-image lift. Its modulePull is the resulting constant-coefficient module inverse image. No properness or finite-type hypothesis, completion comparison, or coherence assertion is imposed.
